name: std-knowledge-tracing
description: std-knowledge-tracing — turns one true/false observation ('did the learner get this right?') into a tracked belief about mastery, and captures the same observation as a labeled training example in the same motion. Composes std-ml-posterior (the R2 statistical rung — a Beta-Bernoulli belief over an unknown success rate) with std-ml-label-capture: every posterior verdict — MASTERY_REACHED, REMEDIATION_NEEDED, or the abstain EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT — becomes a persisted labeled example (the input skill, the posterior's own verdict, and the ground-truth outcome that produced it), so a cheaper rung can later be trained to reproduce the same call without running the statistics. Domain-agnostic: it knows about skills and observations, not students, quizzes, or courses. One instance tracks one belief (e.g. one learner × one skill); the host composes as many instances as it has beliefs to hold.

events.name: Mastery Reached
events.description: The posterior mean clears masteryFloor with a credible interval narrow enough to trust.

events.name: Remediation Needed
events.description: The posterior mean is at or below remediationCeiling with a credible interval narrow enough to trust.

events.name: Evidence Insufficient
events.description: The abstain — the credible interval is still wider than intervalWidthMax, so no verdict is licensed yet.

masteryFloor.label: Mastery floor
masteryFloor.description: Posterior mean at or above this, with a tight interval, licenses MASTERY_REACHED.

priorAlpha.label: Prior alpha
priorAlpha.description: Beta prior success pseudo-count before any observation.

priorBeta.label: Prior beta
priorBeta.description: Beta prior failure pseudo-count before any observation.

remediationCeiling.label: Remediation ceiling
remediationCeiling.description: Posterior mean at or below this, with a tight interval, licenses REMEDIATION_NEEDED.

intervalWidthMax.label: Max credible-interval width
intervalWidthMax.description: Above this width the posterior is too uncertain to decide — abstain with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.

sampleCount.label: Posterior sample count
sampleCount.description: Number of Monte Carlo draws from the Beta posterior used to estimate the credible interval.

fields.name: alpha
fields.description: Beta distribution success count (prior + observed successes).

fields.name: beta
fields.description: Beta distribution failure count (prior + observed failures).

fields.name: intervalLow
fields.description: Lower bound of the last computed credible interval.

fields.name: intervalHigh
fields.description: Upper bound of the last computed credible interval.

fields.name: observations
fields.description: Number of observations folded into the posterior so far.

emits.description: Fired after a labeled example is persisted.

events.description: Fired after a labeled example is persisted.

sampleRate.label: Sample rate
sampleRate.description: Fraction of examples to keep (1 = capture all). A prob/flip trial per observation.

sink.label: Label sink
sink.description: Named destination this batch of examples is attributed to; interpreted downstream (the physical label store is not yet decided).

fields.name: verdict
